id./param/scenario/cs/b_120_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Is Veronica here? I don't see her anywhere.
"Veronica and I played here together since childhood. I was sure she'd be here...
"Veronica! Veronica! Where are you!?
"Oh... Veronica. So you were here.
"Wake up, Veronica. You'll catch a cold.
"...Veronica, what's wrong?
"Veronica's staff is glowing... and {var:1}'s hand too...
"{var:1}, please touch this staff. Perhaps...
That scene returns...
"No, Yggdrasil...
"At this rate the world...
"I must do something quickly or everyone will be killed...
"I don't care what happens to me... Everyone, survive no matter what and save the world from him!
"Serena... Let's be born again someday on the same leaf. Look after {var:1}.
"Veronica... To save us...
"Veronica... You wrung out your last strength for us...
"...Damn!!
"Veronica...
"The young are in such a rush to die...
"Veronica is gone. ...Nowhere to be found.
"If this is what Veronica chose... I accept all of it.
"I must tell Father, Mother, and everyone in the village properly..."
